designInfo.interventionModelDescription: This study is a randomized, controlled, open-label clinical trial.

armGroups.label: ESG + lifestyle modification
armGroups.description: Endoscopic sleeve gastroplasty weight loss procedure with a lifestyle modification program for 12 months.

interventions.name: ESG + lifestyle modification
interventions.description: Endoscopic sleeve gastroplasty - an endoscopic weight loss procedure where an endoscopic suturing device is utilized to reduce the size of the stomach by 70%.

interventions.name: Lifestyle modification
interventions.description: Lifestyle modification program consisting of diet and exercise therapy

primaryOutcomes.measure: MASH resolution without worsening of liver fibrosis at 12 months
primaryOutcomes.description: Comparison of endoscopic ultrasound (EUS)-guided liver biopsy results to assess MASH resolution at 12 months compared to baseline in the ESG + lifestyle modification (LM) group compared to LM alone group.

secondaryOutcomes.measure: An improvement of liver fibrosis by at least one stage without worsening of MASH at 12 months
secondaryOutcomes.description: Comparison of endoscopic ultrasound (EUS)-guided liver biopsy results to assess an improvement of liver fibrosis at 12 months compared to baseline in the ESG + lifestyle modification (LM) group compared to LM alone group.

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Change in liver stiffness on MRE at 12 months
secondaryOutcomes.description: Comparison of liver stiffness measurement on magnetic resonance elastography (MRE) at 12 months compared to baseline in the ESG + lifestyle modification (LM) group compared to LM alone group.

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Change in liver stiffness on VCTE at 12 months
secondaryOutcomes.description: Comparison of liver stiffness measurement on vibration-controlled transient elastography (VCTE) at 12 months compared to baseline in the ESG + lifestyle modification (LM) group compared to LM alone group.

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Change in liver fibrosis using NFS at 12 months
secondaryOutcomes.description: Comparison of NAFLD fibrosis score (NFS) at 12 months compared to baseline in the ESG + lifestyle modification (LM) group compared to LM alone group.

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Change in liver fibrosis using ELF score at 12 months
secondaryOutcomes.description: Comparison of ELF at 12 months compared to baseline in the ESG + lifestyle modification (LM) group compared to LM alone group.

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Change in liver fibrosis using FIB-4 at 12 months
secondaryOutcomes.description: Comparison of Fibrosis-4 (FIB-4) score at 12 months compared to baseline in the ESG + lifestyle modification (LM) group compared to LM alone group.

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Change in liver fat content using MRI-PDFF at 12 months
secondaryOutcomes.description: Comparison of liver fat content using MRI proton density fat fraction (MRI-PDFF) at 12 months compared to baseline in the ESG + lifestyle modification (LM) group compared to LM alone group.

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Change in liver fat content using VCTE CAP score at 12 months
secondaryOutcomes.description: Comparison of liver fat content measured by controlled attenuation parameter (CAP) score on vibration-controlled transient elastography (VCTE) at 12 months compared to baseline in the ESG + lifestyle modification (LM) group compared to LM alone group.

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Change in portosystemic pressure gradient (PPG) measurements at 12 months
secondaryOutcomes.description: Comparison of portosystemic pressure gradient (PPG) measurements at 12 months compared to baseline in the ESG + lifestyle modification (LM) group compared to LM alone group.

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Percent total weight loss (%TWL) at 12 months
secondaryOutcomes.description: Comparison of weight loss at 12 months compared to baseline in the ESG + lifestyle modification (LM) group compared to LM alone group.

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Change in quality of life at 12 months
secondaryOutcomes.description: Compare changes in quality of life assessed using chronic liver disease questionnaire at 12 months compared to baseline in the ESG + lifestyle modification (LM) group compared to LM alone group

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Change in eating behaviors at 12 months
secondaryOutcomes.description: Compare changes in eating behaviors evaluated using the Three Factor Eating Questionnaire (TFEQ) at 12 months compared to baseline in the ESG + lifestyle modification (LM) group compared to LM alone group.

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Change in physical, mental and social well-being at 12 months
secondaryOutcomes.description: Compare changes in physical, mental and social well-being using the Patient-reported Outcomes Measurement Information System (PROMIS) at 12 months compared to baseline in the ESG + lifestyle modification (LM) group compared to LM alone group.

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Change in insulin resistance at 12 months
secondaryOutcomes.description: Compare changes in insulin resistance using Homeostatic Model Assessment of Insulin Resistance (HOMA-IR) and Hemoglobin (HbA1c) values at 12 months compared to baseline in the ESG + lifestyle modification (LM) group compraed to LM alone group. groups

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Change in gut hormones at 12 months
secondaryOutcomes.description: Compare changes in gut hormones using ghrelin, GIP, GLP-1, PYY values at 12 months compared to baseline in the ESG + lifestyle modification (LM) group compraed to LM alone group. groups

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Change in bile acids at 12 months
secondaryOutcomes.description: Compare changes in bile acid values from blood samples at 12 months compared to baseline in the ESG + lifestyle modification (LM) group compraed to LM alone group. groups

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Safety parameters post-procedure
secondaryOutcomes.description: Rate of serious adverse events, defined as those classified as grade III-V according to the Clavien-Dindo classification in the ESG + LM group and LM alone group.

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Change in body composition as measured by Dual-Energy X-ray Absorptiometry (DEXA) scan at 12 months (Brigham and Women's Hospital Only)
secondaryOutcomes.description: Comparison of Dual-Energy X-ray Absorptiometry (DEXA) scan measurements at 12 months compared to baseline in the ESG + lifestyle modification (LM) group compared to LM alone group.

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Change in liver stiffness on Shear Wave Elastography at 12 months
secondaryOutcomes.description: Comparison of liver stiffness measurement on Shear wave elastography (SWE) at 12 months compared to baseline in the ESG + lifestyle modification (LM) group compared to LM alone group.

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Change in liver fat content on attenuation imaging (ATT) at 12 months
secondaryOutcomes.description: Comparison of liver fat content measurements using endoscopic attenuation imaging (ATT) at 12 months compared to baseline in the ESG + lifestyle modification (LM) group compared to LM alone group.

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Change in grip strength measurements at 12 months (Brigham and Women's Hospital Only)
secondaryOutcomes.description: Comparison of grip strength measurements using a handheld dynamometer at 12 months compared to baseline in the ESG + lifestyle modification (LM) group compared to LM alone group.

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Change in physical performance measurements at 12 months (Brigham and Women's Hospital Only)
secondaryOutcomes.description: Comparison of physical performance measurements based on a 6-meter walk test at 12 months compared to baseline in the ESG + lifestyle modification (LM) group compared to LM alone group.
